title: Perspectives About Online Information
summary: The purpose of this research study is to understand the perspectives of U.S. adults on online information about prostate cancer. Study participants will receive different online information about prostate cancer to view such as a video post or text post, and complete a one-time online survey that will take approximately 10 minutes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. U.S. adult age 40+ who identifies as Black and/or Hispanic
2. Enrolled in Dynata online survey panel
3. Willing and able to participate in the research study.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Individuals up to age 39
2. Individuals living outside the U.S.
3. Individuals who are not Black and/or Hispanic
